title: E-commerce
summary: Online stores with product catalogs, carts, online payments and order management your staff can run day to day.
description: We build online stores that your staff can run without calling a developer: adding products, changing prices, handling orders and refunds. Customers can pay online or on delivery, and you see every order and its status in one place.
included: Product catalog with categories, variants and stock
Cart, checkout and online payment or cash on delivery
Order management with status updates for customers
Discount codes and delivery charges by area
